$description: Golem spacing, border width and sizing. Golem calls its spacing scale 'padding' — there is no separate margin scale, because layout gaps are auto-layout padding/gap, never margins. The ES Spacing spacer component is deprecated: use auto-layout with these values instead.

xl.$description: Standard screen side padding on all breakpoints.
